# IArm
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/origin/IArm.sol)

**Title:**
IArm

Interface for the Origin Automated Redemption Manager (ARM)


## Functions
### requestRedeem

Request to redeem liquidity provider shares for liquidity assets


```solidity
function requestRedeem(uint256 shares) external returns (uint256 requestId, uint256 assets);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`shares`|`uint256`|The amount of shares the redeemer wants to burn for liquidity assets|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`requestId`|`uint256`|The index of the withdrawal request|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The amount of liquidity assets that will be claimable by the redeemer|

## Structs
### WithdrawalRequest
A queued withdrawal request awaiting claim


```solidity
struct WithdrawalRequest {
    address withdrawer;
    bool claimed;
    uint40 timestamp; // timestamp of the withdrawal request
    // Amount of oTokens to redeem. eg OETH
    uint128 amount;
    // cumulative total of all withdrawal requests including this one.
    // this request can be claimed when this queued amount is less than or equal to the queue's claimable amount.
    uint128 queued;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawer`|`address`|The address that requested the withdrawal|
|`claimed`|`bool`|Whether the request has already been claimed|
|`timestamp`|`uint40`|The timestamp of the withdrawal request|
|`amount`|`uint128`|The amount of oTokens to redeem (e.g. OETH)|
|`queued`|`uint128`|The cumulative total of all withdrawal requests including this one; claimable once the queue's claimable amount reaches this value|
